title: Shiraishi An — Swaying On The Road At Dusk〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Card: Swaying On The Road At Dusk（4★）

rows.Line: Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Alright, that's good...
Let's end today's practice session here.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Woohoo! Wait, it's already this late...?
Thanks for sticking around for so long, Dad.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Don't mind me.
Just make sure to rest up tonight, okay?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay, I will!
But you should also get some rest since you've been driving super long distances every day. You wouldn't want Mom to worry, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me! You gotta hear this!

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Hm? Hear what?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We had a little gathering earlier today to tell Toya about our thoughts, feelings and experiences in order to help him with his song.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: He took everything that we said and organized it into a massive timeline in his notebook! Isn't that so him?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Sure sounds like it.
You really get to see what makes a person tick when they're writing a song.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I know, right...?
Also, didn't each member of your team have their own unique style?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Yeah, which complicated things a lot...
Nagi and Taiga both create through feeling, but in completely different ways. To them, my way of thinking was inconceivable...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Right?
Oh yeah, they also taught in really different ways.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Those were such good times.
Remember how I used to follow you guys around and nag you to teach me how to write songs?
A few years earlier

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
It needs to go more...
Rawr! You know what I mean?!

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Rawr...?
So, heavier? More bass?

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Hmm... No, that's not it...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
It's not...?
You could be a little more specific...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Still, I wasn't expecting to be asked to help make a song just after finishing a show.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Nagi said she already promised to meet with some friends, and Taiga... He just straight-up ran away.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: To be fair, their mottos as teachers are “feel don't think” and “listen to your heart,” which wouldn't make any sense to a kid. I guess it's up to me to be her teacher...

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Daddy! What are you doing talking to yourself?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Oh, nothing.
Anyway, let me show you how to do this.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Okay! Thank you, Mr. Shiraishi!
Several dozen minutes later

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: So, if you want the chorus here to sound more powerful, try applying the example we just talked about and...

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Hm? An...?
You seem unsatisfied. Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: I don't get the way you teach! You keep talking about chords and rhythmic patterns and stuff...!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Yeah, this sounds more like what I wanted... But can't you teach more like Aunt Nagi?! I always get what she's talking about!

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Like her? Now you're asking too much...

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
What?!
Daddy, you meanie!

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: I'm not trying to be mean or anything...

rows.Speaker: Musician
rows.Line: Hey, what are father and daughter doing causing all this ruckus? If you guys are free, wanna come see us perform? We'll be on stage soon—

rows.Speaker: Musician
rows.Line:
Hm? What's with the laptop...?
Are you guys playing a game together or something?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: No, I was teaching her how to make her own tracks.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Yeah! I'm busy creating!

rows.Speaker: Musician
rows.Line: You're making your own, An?!

rows.Speaker: Musician
rows.Line: In the green room for an event of all places... You're like a real artist already, An! Good luck!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Thanks! I'll let you listen to it once it's done! Anyway, bye bye!
se_walk_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
Hey, did you hear that?
I'm like a real artist already!

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: In terms of drive, you sure sound like one already.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Anyway, where were we?
You're going to knock their socks off, right? So, you've gotta make your track a good one.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I ended up finishing that track after asking all three of you about it.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
I remember.
And you basically went with Nagi's style in the end...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What choice did I have? I didn't know what I was doing back then! Actually, I still don't really understand the theory behind it all...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
But don't worry!
I think your way of teaching is really easy to understand now, Dad!

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
That's good to hear.
For a second there, I was worried that you were going to say, “I still don't get what you're saying!” and ask me to change the way I teach.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha! I wouldn't do that to you!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Anyway, Mr. Shiraishi, I'm looking forward to learning lots more from you!

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Oh, you better be ready since you still have plenty to learn.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I am!
